note: AOI definition as a first-class symbol with a typed signature, plus one call site exercising positional binding. The arity rule measured on the Egan corpus is 1 + count(Required parameters excluding EnableIn and EnableOut), which held at 418 of 418 call sites; here that is 1 + 3 = 4 operands. Operand 0 is the backing instance tag and operands 1..n bind positionally to the required parameters in declaration order. Direction comes from Usage: Input binds a read, Output binds a write, InOut binds both because it is passed by reference. The instance tag is always written. EnableIn and EnableOut are emitted on every AOI by the export and are deliberately NOT symbols - they carry no design intent and would add two noise symbols per definition. AOI logic is hermetically encapsulated in this corpus (zero references outside its own parameters and local tags across all 2,156 AOI rungs), so the internal edges target AOI-scoped FQNs and never leak to controller tags.
